name: robotforge
description: Beginner robot playground: design, load or import robots in plain language, simulate them in MuJoCo, watch them in a live 3D viewer, compare controllers and learn embodied AI lesson by lesson.

interface.longDescription: Describe a robot in plain words and robotforge builds it: arms, robot dogs, rovers, humanoids, real robots like the Unitree Go2, or your own URDF. Make it walk, drive or pick things up, watch it live in a 3D viewer, compare PD, LQR and MPC, write Python scripts, and follow nine short lessons into embodied AI.
defaultPrompt: 给我一只四足机器狗，放在草地上，让它往前走 10 秒。
